description: This file defines the LogConsistencyProvider class which implements an interface for log view adaptation in Orleans's event sourcing storage. It provides methods and properties to facilitate storage and retrieval of log views with support for multi-cluster scenarios.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProvider
classes.description: A provider that manages storing and retrieving log views with an emphasis on concurrency control via primary storage and supporting multiple clusters.

methods.name: UsesStorageProvider
methods.description: Property indicating that this provider uses storage, always returns true.

methods.name: MakeLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LogViewAdaptor for managing log views and entries, with support for concurrency and multi-cluster communication.

calls: new LogViewAdaptor<TView,TEntry>(hostGrain, initialState, grainStorage, grainTypeName, services)
